title: The International 2018: Results
summary: OpenAI Five lost two games against top Dota 2 players at The International in Vancouver this week, maintaining a good chance of winning for the first 20–35 minutes of both games.
body: OpenAI Five lost two games against top Dota 2 players at The International in Vancouver this week, maintaining a good chance of winning for the first 20–35 minutes of both games.
summaryZh: OpenAI Five在2018年Dota 2国际邀请赛中与顶尖职业选手对战。尽管最终失利，但模型在比赛前20-35分钟展现了极强的竞技能力，验证了强化学习在复杂实时策略游戏中的潜力。

aiReview.reasonZh: 记录了OpenAI Five在国际赛事中的表现，是早期强化学习在复杂博弈场景中的重要测试。
